_comment: All GPIO numbers use BCM (Broadcom) numbering. See docs/hardware-setup.md for the wiring diagram.

fire._comment: Primary fire / jump / action. Maps to RetroPad A button.

action2._comment: Secondary action (barrel roll in 1942, etc). Maps to RetroPad B button.

action3._comment: Tertiary action. Maps to RetroPad X button.

action4._comment: Quaternary action. Maps to RetroPad Y button.

action5._comment: Fifth action. Maps to RetroPad L shoulder button.

action6._comment: Sixth action. Maps to RetroPad R shoulder button.

coin._comment: Insert credit. Maps to RetroPad Select.

start._comment: Player 1 Start. Maps to RetroPad Start.

player2_start._comment: Hold BTN 5 + BTN 6 together for 2-Player Start (alternating two-player games). Sent on a second virtual gamepad so MAME reads it as P2 Start. Neither button is a RetroArch hotkey modifier, so it does not collide with save-state (Coin + BTN 6 would).
